# OpenVidu

> Self-hosted video conferencing & custom WebRTC: deploy OpenVidu Meet in minutes or build with OpenVidu Platform SDKs.

Self-hosted videoconference solution and SDK

- [WebComponent](https://openvidu.io/3.8/meet/embedded/tutorials/embedding-options/webcomponent/index.md): An OpenVidu Meet tutorial for embedding OpenVidu Meet using the OpenVidu Meet WebComponent. It uses Node.js and Express for the backend and plain HTML/CSS/JavaScript for the frontend.
- [WebComponent Commands & Events](https://openvidu.io/3.8/meet/embedded/tutorials/embedding-options/webcomponent-advanced/index.md): An OpenVidu Meet WebComponent tutorial demonstrating how to use the OpenVidu Meet Component programmatically and respond to meeting events. It includes usage of features of OpenVidu Meet such as WebComponent commands, event handling, role-based UI, meeting header, and enhanced room management.
- [Anonymous Access](https://openvidu.io/3.8/meet/embedded/tutorials/access/anonymous-access/index.md): An OpenVidu Meet tutorial showing how individuals can join a room through anonymous access links (moderator or speaker). It uses Node.js and Express for the backend and plain HTML/CSS/JavaScript for the frontend.
- [Identified Guests](https://openvidu.io/3.8/meet/embedded/tutorials/access/identified-guests/index.md): An OpenVidu Meet tutorial showing how to add identified guests with a fixed name and a unique access link to a room. It uses Node.js and Express for the backend and plain HTML/CSS/JavaScript for the frontend.
- [Users](https://openvidu.io/3.8/meet/embedded/tutorials/access/users/index.md): An OpenVidu Meet tutorial showing how to create users with the Users API and add them to a room as members. It uses Node.js and Express for the backend and plain HTML/CSS/JavaScript for the frontend.
- [Recordings](https://openvidu.io/3.8/meet/embedded/tutorials/advanced-features/recordings/index.md): How to add recording management capabilities to an OpenVidu Meet WebComponent application. It includes listing recordings, viewing recordings and deleting recordings.
- [Webhooks](https://openvidu.io/3.8/meet/embedded/tutorials/advanced-features/webhooks/index.md): Learn how to build a real-time video conferencing application using Node.js and JavaScript with live updates through webhooks and Server-Sent Events.

- [Performant](https://openvidu.io/3.8/docs/self-hosting/production-ready/performance/index.md): OpenVidu Platform 2x performance by using mediasoup to replace the original Pion LiveKit WebRTC engine while maintaining the LiveKit API.

- [Fault Tolerant](https://openvidu.io/3.8/docs/self-hosting/production-ready/fault-tolerance/index.md): OpenVidu is designed from the ground up to be fault tolerant in all its services in case of node downtime, especially in its High Availability deployment.
- [Observability](https://openvidu.io/3.8/docs/self-hosting/production-ready/observability/index.md): A description of OpenVidu's observability toolset to monitor and analyze your deployment in real-time, consisting of OpenVidu Dashboard and a Grafana stack.
